summary: A deprecated standalone TypeScript client package (@barkpark/client) for the Barkpark v1 HTTP API — a thin, strongly-typed, immutable fetch wrapper that predates the workspace/project hierarchy and has been superseded by @barkpark/core. Its build tooling (tsup) targets ESM+CJS dual output with type declarations.

intentions.title: Provide a typed, framework-agnostic JS client for the Barkpark v1 API
intentions.evidence: packages/client/src/client.ts exports Client class with query, mutate, create, patch, publish, schema methods; types.ts defines the full HTTP contract surface

intentions.title: Support dual ESM+CJS distribution with TypeScript declarations
intentions.evidence: tsup.config.ts: format: ['esm','cjs'], dts: true, sourcemap: true — ensures the package works in both Node.js CJS environments and modern ESM bundlers

intentions.title: Document and enforce deprecation in favour of @barkpark/core
intentions.evidence: client.ts JSDoc @deprecated block explicitly names @barkpark/core as successor, notes the flat /v1/... URL shape limitation vs workspace-scoped routing, and instructs 'Do not add features here'

intentions.title: Enable atomic batch mutations
intentions.evidence: mutate() method in client.ts accepts Mutation[] and posts to /v1/data/mutate — comment states 'Either all succeed or none do — on failure the whole batch rolls back'
